subject: general
question: Pipes A nd B can fill a tank in 18 hours and 27 hours, respectively. If both the pipes are opened on alternate hours, one at a time, and pipe A is opened for the first hour, then in how many hours will the tank be filled completely?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by pipe A = 18 hrs

Time taken by pipe B = 27 hrs

**Formula used:**

Efficiency = Total work done/ total time taken

**Calculation:**

Let the total volume of the tank be the LCM of 18 and 27 i.e. 54 unit

The efficiency of A = 54/18 = 3

Efficiency of B = 54/27 = 2

Tank filled by both pipes together in 2 days (A starts the work) = 3 +2 = 5 unit

Tank filled by both pipes together in 20 days = 50 unit

Now, on the 21st day, A will fill 3 units of tank

Total tank filled till now = 53 unit

On the 22ⁿd day, B will work and will fill 2 units of the tank, but we need only 1 unit of more work. Hence B will work only half a day

Total number of days taken = 21(1)/(2) days

**∴ The total number of days taken by A and B together to fill the tank completely is 21(1)/(2) days**
